description.value: Les Faux Bourgeois is an award-winning French bistro and café on East 15th Avenue in Vancouver's east side, consistently voted the city's best French restaurant by Georgia Straight readers across multiple years. The menu centres on classic Parisian bistro fare — duck confit, beef tartare, French onion soup — in a relaxed neighbourhood setting that one reviewer likened to the bistros of Paris itself. A take-out option is available for cyclists wanting to eat on the move.

bike_parking_detail: 5 racks within 100m: stands at 9m; stands (2 spaces) at 84m; rack at 85m; stands (2 spaces) at 86m; stands (2 spaces) at 97m. Total: 6 spaces.
